name: test-model-qwen3-8b-pd-nixl
author: ModelTC
description: LightLLM Qwen3-8b PD disaggregation gsm8k: pd_master on 8089, prefill on 8001, decode on 8002, tp 2 each. Assign four GPUs via nvidia-smi then export PREFILL_CUDA_DEVICES / DECODE_CUDA_DEVICES (no fixed card IDs; no complex shell automation). UCX_NET_DEVICES and TLS for RDMA per cluster. lm_eval hits pd_master URL. HOST vs PD_MASTER_IP when co-located. Before lm_eval, must POST one completion via curl to pd_master for warmup verification. Requires LOG_DIR, MODEL_DIR, proxy cleared, no_proxy, summary.txt. Same-GPU model_infer + pd_*_trans need NVIDIA MPS for best KV copy perf; record MPS on/off in summary. Run check_nvidia_peermem.sh in this skill dir; record in summary.txt. Use for PD separation tests with either NIXL transport or the default NCCL transport.
